title: Endpoint route exchange is not mesh discovery
summary: XTP common-header ROUTE and CNTL XROUTE carry endpoint exchange hints; they are not a signed node/service publication directory and do not imply a multi-hop XTP router.
invariants: No elevation of unsigned ROUTE/XROUTE values into trust policy
No inferred forwarding path from a single endpoint route exchange
IP/interface/MAC only in XTP route/candidate records, not service descriptors
Node publication is control application DATA on authenticated xtp.provision, not a new meaning of ROUTE wire bits
procedure: Use XTP endpoint route exchange for current supported mechanics only
Install centrally authorised configuration via staged local gateway action
Gate any new multi-hop router capability on independent forwarding and loop/failure qualification
